statement: At bind, xpad starts wireless receiver input without a controller input node and requests connection information. It interprets wireless input byte 0 bit 3 as a status change and byte 1 bit 7 as controller presence, scheduling per-interface work; bit 6 denotes headset presence. Ordinary pad reports use a separate valid-input condition.
